desc.en: Emperor of the sea. Enter its territory and you are sure to drown and be turned into a bloated corpse with bite marks.
desc.ja: 渦の底に眠る、大海の帝王。自らの領域を侵される事を最も嫌い、侵入者の気配を察知すると目を覚まし猛威を振るう。不幸にもその怒りに触れた者は、海の藻屑となるしかない。

note: Galaxy rank, talk to the adventurer near Cordelia, new point on world map opens up
